title: Elodie and the Tide
author: W. M. Eriksen
blurb: Jude Thackeray, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, believes second chances are for people with better timing. But when the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must let someone stay after the last train leaves before the bakery lease runs out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
